## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, what changes, and how the user experiences the result.

- Changed components:

## Verification

- Exact commands and results:
- Operating system, Qt version, compiler, and source revision:
- Hardware-free tests and any separate hardware evidence:
- Remaining limitations:

## Review

- [ ] No credentials, device identifiers, customer data, or proprietary binaries are included.
- [ ] New diagnostic commands remain on the reviewed allowlist and target one selected device.
- [ ] Timeout, cancellation, exit status, and failure cases are tested when relevant.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented, experimentally tested, and planned behavior.
- [ ] Dependencies and redistributed assets have documented provenance and permissions.

## Rollback

State how to revert the code change and whether any data migration would need separate handling.
